title: Great House Farm, Llandough, Cardiff (BP vs Buckler 1987)
outcome: Taken off hold on 2 September 2026 with a promised reply by 23 September; no reply since.

messages.summary: Clarification of FOI CAS-347296-M0V4Y1 (linked to CAS-344046-K1S1R2): records on Great House Farm / Tŷ Mawr, Llandough, c.1936–1950, including National Farm Survey / MAFF and Glamorgan War Agricultural Executive Committee material.
Request taken off hold; response promised by 23 September 2026.
messages.body_public:
Dear Ret'd Sergeant [requester] Buckler,
Thank you for providing clarification.
We have taken your request off hold and we will respond to you
by 23/09/2026.
Yours sincerely,
FOI Assessor
Freedom of Information Centre
The National Archives

statement: Our case, prospective. Not a finding of any court.
